lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a non-linear grid pattern on the mid-lateral flank, specifically in the region immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with circular high-luminance blobs on the posterior flank, creating a discernible grid-like anchor node structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature running across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition between dorsal light and lateral shadow.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of discrete, high-luminance blobs visible within the dark silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily located along the anterior edge and basal region.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-chroma yellow biotic feature (small fish) is located in the water column immediately adjacent to the ventral tip of the left pectoral fin.
